optional_leads.title: OME-NGFF derived-image export
optional_leads.detail: Choose a dedicated writer and verify with independent reader; TIFF-backed Zarr alone is insufficient.

optional_leads.title: napari plugin or Qt canvas
optional_leads.detail: Pin exact released napari/Qt set and qualify integration; project service owns persistence/undo.

optional_leads.title: Additional readers
optional_leads.detail: CZI, arbitrary NGFF, vendor series and stitching formats need pinned readers and fixtures.

optional_leads.title: GPU rendering
optional_leads.detail: Keep renderer boundary; do not require GPU in v1.

optional_leads.title: Assisted segmentation/registration
optional_leads.detail: Consider after manual annotation and provenance; preserve outputs as derived data.

optional_leads.title: Cloud/concurrent collaboration
optional_leads.detail: Bundle exchange is target; multi-writer/cloud needs conflict and identity design.

optional_leads.title: ITK coordinates and pixel GeoJSON
optional_leads.detail: Possible later registration/interop lead; do not claim local pixel GeoJSON is standard without tested CRS/origin.
